verdict.rationale: The evidence shows protocol and API building blocks: MCP servers and a CLI for catalog search, carts, checkout and orders, server-pushed order webhooks, and UCP/AP2 mandates for autonomous agents within set boundaries. None of it is a product feature that lets a user set up automations that run unattended in the background; there is no scheduler, trigger configuration or managed background runner. Webhook subscriptions are registered server-side through a partner manager and only deliver order events, and the AP2 mandates are protocol primitives a developer would use to build such automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
